newsitem.title: USA: OptiMark Technologies names William Adiletta VP.
newsitem.headline: OptiMark Technologies names William Adiletta VP.

text.p: OptiMark Technologies Inc said on Monday that it appointed William Adiletta executive vice president and chief technology officer.

The company said he will play a key role in developing and bringing to market OptiMark's securities transaction system, which is designed to attract liquidity to the markets, reduce market impact costs and improve investment returns.
Previously, Adiletta was executive vice president of global sales and marketing for Bridges Information Systems, a group of financial information companies.
